All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<E>, Collection<E>, List<E>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<E>, StackADT<E>
public class Stack<E> extends ArrayList<E> implements StackADT<E>
Stack implements a LIFO stack. The bottom of the stack is the beginning of the list
